owner.registry: one loaded SDK image owns its token namespace; it is not a business-engine singleton
owner.engine_payload: engine registration owns one native payload until close drain releases it
owner.subscription_token: the successful observe caller releases the token; parent close never consumes it
owner.callback_context: caller-owned borrowed context; the runtime never frees caller memory
owner.close_progress: requesting thread or the last operation/source-lease owner completes eligible native cleanup; no background worker

thread.initial_callback: observe caller, synchronously before observe returns
thread.subsequent_callback: serialized source caller; test-support emit drives the same source lease implementation
thread.callback_concurrency: at most one source lease per subscription; different subscriptions may run concurrently
thread.native_cleanup: request-close caller or last permit/lease-returning thread; no OS-thread affinity
thread.recursive_source_attempt: WouldDeadlock while Open and this callback holds the source lease; Closing/Closed take precedence after stop

source_lease.acquisition: token lookup, subscription type/state checks, and lease increment share the registry mutex before copying callback/context
source_lease.duration: from source acquisition, including pre-entry delay, through callback return
source_lease.already_admitted_after_stop: may complete; successful close wait is delayed until lease return
source_lease.sequence: strictly increasing per registration without wrapping; exhaustion returns ResourceExhausted

stop.request_close: atomically stops new operation/source admission; repeated requests are idempotent and do not wait for callbacks
stop.engine_cascade: closes all child subscriptions while preserving caller ownership of their tokens
stop.registration_failure: unpublished subscription is closed and removed before return; out_subscription is zero and context is no longer referenced

drain.await_closed: success requires native operation permits, source leases, consumer callbacks, and the resource cleanup promised by this handle to finish
drain.engine_dependencies: its admitted operations and every child subscription drain
drain.timeout_ms_zero: poll only; Timeout while Closing and Busy while Open
drain.timeout_effect: ends this wait only; never forces free or reopens admission
drain.in_callback: waiting for the current subscription or its parent returns WouldDeadlock

release.native_payload: actual Box payload drop occurs before engine Closed is published
release.subscription_source: stored callback/context fields are removed before subscription Closed is published
release.release_handle: only Closed tokens are removed; Open/Closing return Busy; repeated removal returns InvalidHandle
release.token_reuse: never reused within the SDK image; monotonically allocated from 1, with ResourceExhausted after u64 exhaustion
release.poison_or_integrity_loss: InternalFailure and retained quarantine; no false Closed or forced cleanup

queue.overflow_policy: not applicable; no consumer queue is admitted

memory_preconditions: Accepted nonempty checksum input denotes readable memory without concurrent mutation for the entire call; null input is allowed only for zero length.
Output objects are nonnull, aligned, writable, mutually disjoint, and disjoint from input; each mechanically valid output is zeroed before other validation.
Bootstrap output is a valid writable 64-byte region only when nonnull and capacity equals 64; another capacity is rejected without writing.
Caller retains callback/context from registration until successful subscription or parent-engine close wait; callback access must be valid on the declared source callers.
Foreign exceptions and panics must not unwind through C callbacks. Rust internal unwind panics map to InternalFailure; abort/OOM has no recovery promise.
Arbitrary dangling pointers, allocation validity, and caller violations cannot be validated by this ABI.

mechanisms.responsibility: bounded synchronous borrow, independent output clearing, stable status/error layout
registry-atomic admission and RAII permit return; input memory remains the call-frame owner responsibility
single registration owner, source-side context lease, rollback, callback reentrancy, and close drain
one status plus initialized output; create/observe transfer only successful handle tokens; no asynchronous completion bridge
native/context cleanup before Closed, followed by explicit caller token release

The explicit diagnostics feature records numeric boundary-returned and callback-returned facts into one bounded 64-slot ring per loaded image. Capture defaults off; diagnostic counters never govern business admission, resource ownership or close completion. One try-lock attempt, drop-new on contention/full, no exporter or worker.

The diagnostics profile exposes configure and single-record drain; the default profile preserves exactly seven native exports. Returned records are caller-owned value copies without payloads or addresses. Consumer exporters run after drain returns and hold no SDK callback context. The generated checked constructor reuses the existing bootstrap and create once; it does not add native ownership or a second diagnostic event.

test_support.protocol_implementation: same Operation, Registration, SourceLease and registry state machine as the default build
test_support.controls: admitted-operation/source-acquisition barriers, counters, monotonic exhaustion, registration failure, internal panic, and isolated diagnostic sink failure
test_support.identity: separate resolved profile from default Release; no certification inferred from this document
